# read plot 3 data

```{r}
# Read the Excel file - third worksheet
ora_data <- read_excel("./ORA_ORG_all.xlsx", sheet = 3)

names(ora_data) <- ora_data[1,]
ora_data <- ora_data[-1, ]

str(ora_data$pvalue)
str(ora_data$p.adjust)
str(ora_data$qvalue)

ora_data$p.adjust <- as.numeric(ora_data$p.adjust)
ora_data$pvalue <- as.numeric(ora_data$pvalue)
ora_data$qvalue <- as.numeric(ora_data$qvalue)

ora_data$Description <- plyr::mapvalues(ora_data$Description, from = c("HYPOXIA"), to = c("CURATED_HYPOXIA"))
```

# p3 helper function

```{r}
###############################
# Function to prepare pathway data
###############################
prepare_pathway_data <- function(quadrant_group, excel_data) {
  # Filter data for the relevant quadrant
  data_subset <- excel_data %>%
    filter(grepl(quadrant_group, group, fixed = TRUE))
  
  # Calculate -log10(p.adjust) and prepare data for plotting
  plot_data <- data_subset %>%
    mutate(
      pathway = sub("^(GOBP_|HALLMARK_|KEGG_)", "", Description),
      #pathway = sub("\\d+$", "", pathway),  # Remove trailing numbers
      neg_log_p = -log10(p.adjust)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(neg_log_p))
  
  return(plot_data)
}
```

# plot 3d

```{r}
###############################
# Plot d: Consensus positive and negative
###############################
# Prepare data for plot d
plot_d_pos <- prepare_pathway_data("MC-Consensus positive", ora_data)
plot_d_neg <- prepare_pathway_data("MC-Consensus negative", ora_data)

# Select top pathways for "Consensus positive"
top_pos_pathways <- c(
  "HYPOXIA",
  "CURATED_HYPOXIA",  # You may need to adjust this based on actual data
  "TRANSMEMBRANE_RECEPTOR_PROTEIN_TYROSINE_KINASE_SIGNALING_PATHWAY", # For TK_SIGNALING
  "HEME_METABOLISM",  # For HEME_MTB
  "EPITHELIAL_CELL_DIFFERENTIATION"  # For EPITHELIAL_CELL_DIFF
)

# Create dataframe for positive pathways
plot_d_pos_selected <- plot_d_pos %>%
  filter(pathway %in% top_pos_pathways) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p)) %>%
  head(5)

# Handle long pathway names
plot_d_pos_selected <- plot_d_pos_selected %>%
  mutate(
    short_name = case_when(
      #grepl("HYPOXIA", pathway) ~ "HYPOXIA",
      #grepl("CURATED_HYPOXIA", pathway) ~ "CURATED_HYPOXIA", 
      grepl("TYROSINE_KINASE", pathway) ~ "TK_SIGNALING",
      grepl("HEME", pathway) ~ "HEME_MTB",
      grepl("EPITHELIAL_CELL_DIFFERENTIATION", pathway) ~ "EPITHELIAL_CELL_DIFF",
      TRUE ~ pathway
    )
  )

# Select top pathways for "Consensus negative"
top_neg_pathways <- c(
  "E2F_TARGETS",
  "AEROBIC_RESPIRATION",
  "OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION",  # For OXPHOS
  "RIBONUCLEOPROTEIN_COMPLEX_BIOGENESIS",  # For RIBONUCLEOPROTEIN_BIOGENESIS
  "MYC_TARGETS_V2"  # For MYC_TARGETSV2
)

# Create dataframe for negative pathways
plot_d_neg_selected <- plot_d_neg %>%
  filter(pathway %in% top_neg_pathways) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p)) %>%
  filter(Description != "KEGG_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION") %>%
  head(5)

# Handle long pathway names
plot_d_neg_selected <- plot_d_neg_selected %>%
  mutate(
    short_name = case_when(
      grepl("E2F_TARGETS", pathway) ~ "E2F_TARGETS",
      grepl("AEROBIC_RESPIRATION", pathway) ~ "AEROBIC_RESPIRATION",
      grepl("OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION", pathway) ~ "OXPHOS",
      grepl("RIBONUCLEOPROTEIN", pathway) ~ "RIBONUCLEOPROTEIN_BIOGENESIS",
      grepl("MYC_TARGETS", pathway) ~ "MYC_TARGETSV2",
      TRUE ~ pathway
    )
  )

# Combine data for plot d and set factor levels to control the order
plot_d_data <- bind_rows(
  mutate(plot_d_pos_selected, group = "Consensus up"),
  mutate(plot_d_neg_selected, group = "Consensus down")
) %>%
  mutate(short_name = factor(short_name, levels = rev(unique(short_name))))



# Create Plot e
plot_d <- ggplot(plot_d_data, aes(x = neg_log_p, y = short_name, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Consensus up" = "#4cae49", 
                               "Consensus down" = "#fe7e01"),
                    name = "Quadrant") +
  labs(
    x = "-log10(p.adjust)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
plot_d

rm(plot_d_neg, plot_d_pos, plot_d_neg_selected, plot_d_pos_selected, top_neg_pathways, top_pos_pathways)
```

# read plot 4 data

```{r}
# Read the Excel file - first worksheet
ora_data <- read_excel("./ORA_ORG_all.xlsx", sheet = 1)

# Process the dataframe to handle the structure
names(ora_data) <- unlist(ora_data[2, ])
# Remove the 2nd rows that contain headers
ora_data <- ora_data[-c(2), ]

ora_data <- ora_data[,-c(1)] 

# Convert numeric columns to proper numeric type
ora_data$pvalue <- as.numeric(ora_data$pvalue)
ora_data$p.adjust <- as.numeric(ora_data$p.adjust)
ora_data$qvalue <- as.numeric(ora_data$qvalue)

# Function to clean pathway names by removing prefixes
clean_pathway_name <- function(pathway) {
  gsub("^(GOBP_|HALLMARK_|KEGG_)", "", pathway)
}

# Apply the cleaning function to the Description column
ora_data$Description <- plyr::mapvalues(ora_data$Description, from = c("HYPOXIA"), to = c("CURATED_HYPOXIA"))
ora_data$Description_clean <- clean_pathway_name(ora_data$Description)
```

# p4 helper function

```{r}
###############################
# Function to prepare pathway data
###############################
prepare_pathway_data <- function(quadrant_pattern, excel_data) {
  # Filter data for the relevant quadrant
  data_subset <- excel_data %>%
    filter(grepl(quadrant_pattern, group, fixed = TRUE))
  
  # Calculate -log10(p.adjust) and prepare data for plotting
  plot_data <- data_subset %>%
    mutate(
      pathway = Description_clean,
      neg_log_p = -log10(p.adjust)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(neg_log_p))
  
  return(plot_data)
}
```

# plot 4d

```{r}
###############################
# Plot d: Consensus positive and negative
###############################
# Prepare data for plot d
plot_d_pos <- prepare_pathway_data("CC-Consensus positive", ora_data)
plot_d_neg <- prepare_pathway_data("CC-Consensus negative", ora_data)

# Define top pathways for "Consensus positive" based on the screenshot
top_pos_pathways_d <- c(
  "CURATED_HYPOXIA",
  "HYPOXIA",
  "GLYCOLYSIS",
  "MTORC1_SIGNALING",
  "HEME_MTB"
)

# Map the cleaned pathways to the desired display names
pathway_mapping_d_pos <- list(
  "HYPOXIA" = "HYPOXIA",
  "CURATED_HYPOXIA" = "CURATED_HYPOXIA",
  "GLYCOLYTIC_PROCESS" = "GLYCOLYSIS",
  "GLYCOLYSIS" = "GLYCOLYSIS",
  "MTORC1_SIGNALING" = "MTORC1_SIGNALING",
  "HEME_METABOLISM" = "HEME_MTB"
)

# Create dataframe for positive pathways
plot_d_pos_selected <- plot_d_pos %>%
  filter(pathway %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_pos)) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p)) %>%
  mutate(
    short_name = sapply(pathway, function(p) {
      pathway_mapping_d_pos[[p]]
    })
  ) %>%
  group_by(short_name) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take the top pathway if multiple match
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p))

# Define top pathways for "Consensus negative" based on the screenshot
top_neg_pathways_d <- c(
  "E2F_TARGETS",
  "NUCLEAR_DIVISION",
  "CHROMOSOME_SEGREGATION",
  "ORGANELLE_FISSION",
  "G2M_CHECKPOINT"
)

# Map the cleaned pathways to the desired display names

  "E2F_TARGETS" = "E2F_TARGETS",
  "MITOTIC_NUCLEAR_DIVISION" = "NUCLEAR_DIVISION", 
  "CHROMOSOME_SEGREGATION" = "CHR_SEGREGATION",
  "ORGANELLE_FISSION" = "ORGANELLE_FISSION",
  "G2M_CHECKPOINT" = "G2M_CHECKPOINT"
)

# Create dataframe for negative pathways

  filter(pathway %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_neg)) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p)) %>%
  mutate(
    short_name = sapply(pathway, function(p) {
      pathway_mapping_d_neg[[p]]
    })
  ) %>%
  group_by(short_name) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take the top pathway if multiple match
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p))

# Combine data for plot d and set factor levels to control the order
plot_d_data <- bind_rows(
  mutate(plot_d_pos_selected, group = "Consensus up"),
  mutate(plot_d_neg_selected, group = "Consensus down")
) %>%
  mutate(short_name = factor(short_name, levels = rev(c(
    "CURATED_HYPOXIA", "HYPOXIA", "GLYCOLYSIS", "MTORC1_SIGNALING", "HEME_MTB",
    "E2F_TARGETS", "NUCLEAR_DIVISION", "CHR_SEGREGATION", "ORGANELLE_FISSION", "G2M_CHECKPOINT"
  ))))

# Create Plot d
plot_d <- ggplot(plot_d_data, aes(x = neg_log_p, y = short_name, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Consensus up" = "#4cae49", 
                               "Consensus down" = "#fe7e01"),
                    name = "Quadrant") +
  labs(
    x = "-log10(p.adjust)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
plot_d

rm(pathway_mapping_d_neg, pathway_mapping_d_pos, plot_d_neg, plot_d_pos, plot_d_neg_selected, plot_d_pos_selected, top_neg_pathways_d, top_pos_pathways_d)
```

# read plot 5 data

```{r}
# Read the Excel file - second worksheet
ora_data <- read_excel("./ORA_ORG_all.xlsx", sheet = 2)

# Process the dataframe to handle the structure
# First, identify column names from the headers
if ("ID" %in% names(ora_data)) {
  # Column names already set correctly
  names(ora_data) <- names(ora_data)
} else {
  # Find the row with column headers (usually row 2 or 3)
  for (i in 1:5) {
    if (any(grepl("ID", ora_data[i,]))) {
      col_names <- unlist(ora_data[i, ])
      names(ora_data) <- col_names
      ora_data <- ora_data[-c(1:i), ]
      break
    }
  }
}
rm(col_names, i)

ora_data <- ora_data[,-c(1)]

# Convert numeric columns to proper numeric type
ora_data$pvalue <- as.numeric(ora_data$pvalue)
ora_data$p.adjust <- as.numeric(ora_data$p.adjust)
ora_data$qvalue <- as.numeric(ora_data$qvalue)

# Function to clean pathway names by removing prefixes
clean_pathway_name <- function(pathway) {
  gsub("^(GOBP_|HALLMARK_|KEGG_)", "", pathway)
}

# Apply the cleaning function to the Description column
ora_data$Description <- plyr::mapvalues(ora_data$Description, from = c("HYPOXIA"), to = c("CURATED_HYPOXIA"))
ora_data$Description_clean <- clean_pathway_name(ora_data$Description)
```

# p5 helper function

```{r}
###############################
# Function to prepare pathway data
###############################
prepare_pathway_data <- function(quadrant_pattern, excel_data) {
  # Filter data for the relevant quadrant
  data_subset <- excel_data %>%
    filter(grepl(quadrant_pattern, group, fixed = TRUE))
  
  # Calculate -log10(p.adjust) and prepare data for plotting
  plot_data <- data_subset %>%
    mutate(
      pathway = Description_clean,
      neg_log_p = -log10(p.adjust)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(neg_log_p))
  
  return(plot_data)
}
```

# plot 5d

```{r}
###############################
# Plot d: Consensus positive and negative
###############################
# Prepare data for plot d
plot_d_pos <- prepare_pathway_data("TRACER-Consensus positive", ora_data)
plot_d_neg <- prepare_pathway_data("TRACER-Consensus negative", ora_data)

# Define top pathways for "Consensus positive" based on the screenshot
top_pos_pathways_d <- c(
  "ER_STRESS_RESPONSE",
  "CURATED_HYPOXIA",
  "HEME_MTB",
  "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA",
  "MTORC1_SIGNALING"
)

# Map the cleaned pathways to the desired display names
pathway_mapping_d_pos <- list(
  "RESPONSE_TO_ER_STRESS" = "ER_STRESS_RESPONSE",
  "CURATED_HYPOXIA" = "CURATED_HYPOXIA",
  "HEME_METABOLISM" = "HEME_MTB",
  "HYPOXIA" = "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA",
  "MTORC1_SIGNALING" = "MTORC1_SIGNALING"
)

# Create dataframe for positive pathways
plot_d_pos_selected <- plot_d_pos %>%
  filter(pathway %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_pos) | Description_clean %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_pos)) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p)) %>%
  mutate(
    short_name = sapply(Description_clean, function(p) {
      if (p %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_pos)) {
        return(pathway_mapping_d_pos[[p]])
      } else if (pathway %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_pos)) {
        return(pathway_mapping_d_pos[[pathway]])
      } else {
        return(p)
      }
    })
  ) %>%
  group_by(short_name) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take the top pathway if multiple match
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p))

# Define top pathways for "Consensus negative" based on the screenshot
top_neg_pathways_d <- c(
  "RIBOSOME_BIOGENESIS",
  "MYC_TARGETS_V2",
  "NCRNA_PROCESSING",
  "E2F_TARGETS",
  "MYC_TARGETS_V1"
)

# Map the cleaned pathways to the desired display names
pathway_mapping_d_neg <- list(
  "RIBOSOME_BIOGENESIS" = "RIBOSOME_BIOGENESIS",
  "MYC_TARGETS_V2" = "MYC_TARGETS_V2", 
  "NCRNA_PROCESSING" = "NCRNA_PROCESSING",
  "E2F_TARGETS" = "E2F_TARGETS",
  "MYC_TARGETS_V1" = "MYC_TARGETS_V1"
)

# Create dataframe for negative pathways
plot_d_neg_selected <- plot_d_neg %>%
  filter(pathway %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_neg) | Description_clean %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_neg)) %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p)) %>%
  mutate(
    short_name = sapply(Description_clean, function(p) {
      if (p %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_neg)) {
        return(pathway_mapping_d_neg[[p]])
      } else if (pathway %in% names(pathway_mapping_d_neg)) {
        return(pathway_mapping_d_neg[[pathway]])
      } else {
        return(p)
      }
    })
  ) %>%
  group_by(short_name) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take the top pathway if multiple match
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(neg_log_p))

# Combine data for plot d and set factor levels to control the order
plot_d_data <- bind_rows(
  mutate(plot_d_pos_selected, group = "Consensus up"),
  mutate(plot_d_neg_selected, group = "Consensus down")
) %>%
  mutate(short_name = factor(short_name, levels = rev(c(
    "ER_STRESS_RESPONSE", "CURATED_HYPOXIA", "HEME_MTB", "HALLMARK_HYPOXIA", "MTORC1_SIGNALING",
    "RIBOSOME_BIOGENESIS", "MYC_TARGETS_V2", "NCRNA_PROCESSING", "E2F_TARGETS", "MYC_TARGETS_V1"
  ))))

# Create Plot d
plot_d <- ggplot(plot_d_data, aes(x = neg_log_p, y = short_name, fill = group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Consensus up" = "#8e44ad", 
                               "Consensus down" = "#e74c3c"),
                    name = "Quadrant") +
  labs(
    x = "-log10(p.adjust)",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
plot_d

rm(pathway_mapping_d_neg, pathway_mapping_d_pos, plot_d_neg, plot_d_pos, plot_d_neg_selected, plot_d_pos_selected, top_neg_pathways_d, top_pos_pathways_d)
```
